chem-anly-01-c2.quote: the standard is added to the sample to correct for ‘matrix effects’
chem-anly-01-c2.claim: Standard addition adds known amounts of analyte directly to the unknown sample. It corrects for matrix effects, where different sample components affect the analytical signal
